newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA TO MISS GIANT SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA TO MISS GIANT SLALOM.

text.p: Alberto Tomba, 30 on Thursday, ruled out competing in a World Cup giant slalom in Italy at the weekend.

The triple Olympic and double world champion, who was injured during training on a glacier in October, raced for the first time this season in a slalom at Madonna di Campiglio on Tuesday where he finished a remarkable second.
Tomba said after that race that he had not decided whether to compete in Sunday's race at Alta Badia.
On Thursday, his staff issued a statement saying that Tomba had decided to give the demanding event a miss.

"The decision is linked to his desire not to interrupt the programmed training schedule followed since his injury on October 22," it said, adding that Tomba expected to train over the next few days at an unspecified location.
